inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the outdoor play area, there was grass overgrown in the corner.  There was a broken umbrella on a bench in the younger children area.  NOTE: Umbrella was disposed of at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The in-house first aide kit was missing the instruction manual and tweezers.  NOTE items were added to kits at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: There was a gallon of milk observed in the refrigerator past its best by date.  NOTE: Milk disposed at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the outdoor play area, there was grass overgrown in the corner and the liner of the loosefill mulch was ripped and above mulch.  Ivy/weeds overgrown on the fence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Caregiver did not give the proper ages of oldest and youngest child in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: There was garbage on the way to the toddler outdoor play area and garbage inside the toddler outdoor play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Four caregivers did not have a copy of the education requirements for file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: In the larger play area, the loosefill was overgrown with grass/weeds at edges, and there was a wire on the ground from the telephone pole in the play srea.  Bottom of slide had under tarp exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Swings - Not Attached to a Composite Structure: A climbing structure installed on the second playground was observed to have an attached swing set.    NOTE: Corrected at inspection, the swings were removed fromo the structure
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Swings - Not Attached to a Composite Structure (26 TAC §746.4701(c))

occurrences.finding: Training Criteria - Certificate: A certificate was not availalbe to verify the successful completion of preservice training for 2 caregivers present at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Criteria - Certificate (26 TAC §746.1317(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The mulch was not observed to be maintained at the appropriate depth. The tarp beneath the surfacing was observed to be exposed and torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912): One caregiver hired 1/6 did not have a pre-employment affidavit available for review.    NOTE: Corrected at inspection, the affidavit was completed during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The first aid kit on vehicle used to transport children was not observed to be complete. The kit was missing a guide and antiseptic.    NOTE: A second vehicle added but not currently in use did not have a guide, antiseptic and gloves. * Corrected at inspection, all missing items were added to both vehicles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985): One caregiver hired 1/6 did not have a notarized affidavit available for review.    NOTE: Corrected at inspection, the affidavit was completed during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area: The handwashking sink in the infant room was observed to have a bucket in it. Baby bottle on a drying rack were observed next to the sink. The sink is still be used for purposes other than hand washing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3503(d))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: A fire extingusher was observed to be sitting on the floor in a storage closet in the front of the buidling.    NOTE:Corrected at inspection. Fire extinguisher was mounted during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §746.5305)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: A dead german roach was observed under a sink in a restroom used by children.    NOTE: The same roach was observed during the inspection and the operation was infomred to dispose of it  on 9/15.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: One of the restrooms used by children was observed to have ceiling panels that had holes, cracks and signs of water damage. The exhaust fans in both bathrooms appeared to be falling.    The floors in the hallway directly outside of the bathroom was visibly separated and created a tripping hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: One of the restrooms used by children was observed to have 2 ceiling panels that were cracked and bulding down. One of the panels has signs of water damage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: A fire extingusher was observed to be in an unlocked cabinet in the bathroom designated for children
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §746.5305)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area: The handwashking sink in the infant room was observed to have other itmes on and in the sink. Items observed includined cleaning spray and hand sanitizer, a bucket of water, toys and books, a children's tablet, and a walkie talkie.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3503(d))

occurrences.finding: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs: Sign-in logs available did not have completed sign in/out times for all children  Sing in logs rfor the 7/31-8/4 was not available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: A bag of molded cutie oranges was observed in the kitchen.    NOTE: Corrected at inspection, oranges were disposed during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Documentation of emergency medical authorization was not available for 4 children being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: 1 caregiver was observed with 6 children 10mo-20 mo. The specified age group was 12-17 mo. The caregiver wwas over ratio by 1.    NOTE: During the walkthrough, a second caregiver was observed in the kitchen area and entered the classrooom shortly before licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs: Sign-in logs available did not have completed sign in/out times for all children  Sing in logs rfor the 7/31-8/4 was not available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: Documentation of parent contacts and emergency contacts were not available for one child being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care: The driver was observed exiting a bus after transporting children to school. The driver was observed exiting the vehile and looking through each window. After a few minutes, the electronic alarm was triggered and the driver returned and turned the alarm off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care (26 TAC §746.5625(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Crossing Street: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, there was enough information to support a child was allowed to walk across the street to pick up a sibling from school
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Crossing Street (26 TAC §746.5605(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient information that the driver allowed a child to exit the vehicle and walk unsupervised to pick up another child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Access to Personnel Records: The operation did not provide access to one personnel record upon request
occurrences.violation_type_title: Access to Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.909)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: 2 staff were observed to be present at the operation without notification of eligibility from the Centralized background check Unit.     One staff letf prior to end of inspection after receiving an ineligible notice.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extingusiher located on the bus used to tranpsort was observed to be overcharged
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs: Sign-in logs. available did not have sign out times and signatures. Some children signed in were listed by family last name and quantity. Logs did not list names of each child. Sign-in logs for all days where children were in care was not made available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: List of children transported on 8/15 and 8/18 was not listed available for review
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Documentation of emergency medical authorization was not available for any of the 14 children being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: The director and driver and not have transportation training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: Documentation of parent contacts and emergency contacts were not available for the children being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Additional Services Offered: The operation failed to notify Child Care Regulation they began providing transportation services.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §746.301(7))
